summary: Iteration 2 features (Kelola Akun, Upgrade Paket, Bukti Transfer, Laporan Bulanan) tested end-to-end. Backend: 29/29 pytest cases pass covering users CRUD + role rules, package switch 4<->12 (gym 350k/900k, english 495k/1,335k), paid-invoice guard, receipt upload (image/* + non-image 400), file download with query token / Bearer header / 401 / guru 403, and monthly report (bad month 422, structure, guru 403, income reflects a new paid invoice). Frontend (390x844): login -> Beranda shows home-action-report & home-action-users. /users: toggle-add-user-button opens form, create guru works, list refreshes, delete removes row (window.confirm auto-accepted on web). /report: income total (Rp 6.870.000), prev/next month changes report-month-text, 8 class rows, share button visible. /invoice/{id}: amount updates Rp 350.000 <-> Rp 900.000 via invoice-package-switch-4/12, upgrade-offer-banner only shows on 4x, receipt-card + upload-receipt-button present, file-chooser upload succeeds and receipt-image renders. No React Native deprecated packages detected in iter 2 code (expo-image, expo-image-picker, expo-haptics are current). Minor non-blocking: console warning about deprecated 'shadow*' style props (likely from a library).
action_items: (Optional) Investigate RN Web console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Likely from a 3rd-party component; cosmetic only.
(Optional, future) Switch the class-scoped pytest fixtures from instance-methods to @classmethod to silence PytestRemovedIn10Warning.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/users.py delete_user correctly guards self-delete and last-keuangan deletion; good idempotent logic.
routers/extras.py package switch uses PACKAGES map and prevents mutation on paid invoices (400); clean.
storage.py uses lazy init with 503 retry — solid pattern. File download endpoint accepts token via query (for <Image src=>) and Bearer header; keuangan-only enforced server-side.
monthly_report query uses $gte/$lt on timezone-aware UTC bounds; computes income_by_program and per-class attendance counts correctly.
frontend/app/users.tsx and report.tsx are small, focused, and all interactive elements have proper testIDs.
invoice/[id].tsx upload flow uses expo-image-picker with permission guard and settings deeplink — good UX.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and delete their own temporary users/students/invoices (prefixed TEST_). All cleaned up. The seeded keuangan/guru accounts are preserved. One stray test invoice (id 4a94e94d-...) created during UI testing was deleted at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: frontend/.env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Student creation payload is {name, parent_name, parent_phone, class_ids:[...]} (no 'program'/'class_id'). Invoice creation requires {student_id, program, package}. GET /auth/me returns current user. File download: GET /api/files/{path}?token=<jwt>. Mobile viewport 390x844. Deep-linking to /invoice/{id} via page.goto can race with auth hydration (localStorage key: presensi_access_token) and show 'Not authenticated'; prefer SPA navigation via tab-tagihan -> invoice-row-* click.
